senses.gloss: f. (= מְמ׳; מָעַט) small, minute, sparse. דבר מ׳ a little; small (spot &c.).
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Sotah 15:12">Tosef. Sot. XV, 12</cite>, sq.; <cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 2:17">Tosef. B. Bath. II, 17</cite> <he>משייר בה ד׳ מ׳</he> leaves a little portion (of the wall) unfinished in remembrance of the destruction of Jerusalem; <he>משיירת ד׳ מ׳</he> leaves off a little portion of her toilet.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:5">Ḥag. I, 5</cite> <he>זה וזה מ׳</he> if he has little of both.
<cite ref="Mishnah Chagigah 1:8">Ib. 8</cite> <he>שהן מקרא מ׳</he> the Biblical text for these laws is sparse.

<cite ref="Gittin 14a:8">Gitt. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>מתנה מ׳</he> a small gift. Sifra Tsav, ch. XV, Par. 11 <he>סמיכה מ׳</he> the putting on of hands which is rarer (than waving, being confined only to live sacrifices); <he>תנופה מ׳</he> waving which is rarer (being performed by one person only, while putting hands on is done by all sharers in the sacrifice); a. fr.—Pl. <he>מוּעָטִים</he>, <he>מוּעָטִין</he>; <he>מוּעָטוֹת</he>. Ḥag. l. c. <he>אוכלים מרובים ונכסים מ׳</he> many eaters (members of the household partaking of the peace-offering) and small wealth. Ib. <he>עולות מ׳</he> less burnt-offerings (than peace-offerings). Ib. 11ᵃ <he>מקרא … והלכות מ׳</he> the Rabbinical laws sparse in comparison to the profuse Bible text on the subject.
Arakh. 30ᵇ וכי יש … שנים מ׳ are there longer and shorter years?; a. fr.—Esp. מוּעָט, מְמוּעָט the smaller thing, the lesser sphere.

<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 4b:15">R. Hash. 4ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>תפסת מרובה לא תפסת תפסת מ׳ תפסת</he> if you take hold of the larger thing, you may lose your hold, if of the smaller, you will hold it, i.e. where the interpretation is doubtful, select the smaller number; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 2:4:2">Y. Yoma II, end, 40ᵃ</cite> <he>הממ׳</he>. Sifra Vayikra, N’dab., ch. XIII, <cite ref="Mishnah Parah 12">Par. XII</cite> <he>הממ׳</he> the least portion thereof.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 3:8:2">Y. Keth. III, 27ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>בושת הקטן ממ׳</he> the disgrace of a minor is the less grave thing; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Ketubot 3:8:2">ib.</cite> <he>ונזקי ממ׳</he> and the indemnity he gets, is smaller; a. fr.
